title: 第一卷 第2429章 万道阴阳乳第一卷 第2428章 破限十九的可能性
content_zh:
夏侯休不明所以，疑惑的看着林辰。
“你不是希望我能成功吗，那就得帮我，现在来不及解释了，你趴下就是”，林辰道，也没有解释原因。
夏侯休闻言，脸色变了变。
就这样空口无凭的就要他配合，实在有些难以接受。
但夏侯休却也没有多犹豫，随即二话不说，便是趴在了地上。
看得出来，他的确很想要帮到夏侯葵他们。
林辰挑挑眉，也没有多说什么。
他并非有意整蛊夏侯休，也没有闲心开玩笑，他让夏侯休趴下自然有他的道理。
第三重庙宇，跟之前的不同。
在这里，已经能够感受到阴阳乱流所带来的影响，空气之中流转的阴阳之力，都变得狂躁起来，越是往前越是如此。
不过仅此而已，还不至于让林辰却步，林辰还打算继续在第三重庙宇进行探索，探查夏侯家都没有寻到的造化。
“我接下来该如何行事？”夏侯休则是开口问道。
他总不能一直趴在那里。
“仔细去感受就可以了，若是察觉到什么变化，全部印刻而下，传递给我即可，我现在先到前面去看看”，林辰淡淡道，依旧没有多解释什么。
言罢，也不等夏侯休有什么反应，丢下一枚玉珏，他就往前走去。
“你倒是说清楚呀！”夏侯休咬牙。
这算怎么回事，什么叫去感受就可以了，到底应该感受什么？
感受空气中越来越狂躁的力量吗？
那是阴阳乱流造成的影响，感受其中变化，的确有助于进入第四重庙宇之后，去寻叶蓁等人，可这样的帮助实在是有限。
而且真要这么做，也该进入第四重庙宇才是。

在那里将更为清晰！
但林辰已经自顾自往前走去，夏侯休又担心林辰不是无的放矢，真有他这么做的意义在，当下也只好黑着脸，趴着不动，仔细去感受能够感受到的一切。
而林辰往前走，神情却是认真无比。
他并未随意走动的。
他所走的每一步，都是按照第三重庙宇原本存在的阵纹而决定，每一步，都是对大阵的一种呼应，将影响着大阵的运转。
这难度其实很大。
不能有差错。
所以林辰也必须全神贯注，以自身阴阳大道始终去感受阴阳惊天阵的力量，并且随时做出调整，跟随着阵法运转的变化而变化。
第六十六步！
如此，林辰在踏出六十六步之后，一圈圈的涟漪便是从他脚下散开，整个阴阳惊天阵，都被林辰所灌注的阴阳之力所影响，运转出现了人为的改变！
林辰在刻意影响大阵的运转！
对阴阳惊天阵，林辰从进入阴阳庙之后就已经在留意了。
这五重庙宇，每一重的阴阳惊天阵都是连接在一起的，共同组成了这座惊世骇俗的可怕大阵。
这座阵的威能，确实足以刷新林辰的认知，就是比之曾经在神界大墟之中所见的那座诸世杀阵，都不遑多让。
原本这种阵法，林辰最好也是不要去触动，在阵法框架内，顺着阵法同行即可。
但随着林辰对于阴阳大道的理解加深，同时，借助阴阳生死咒能够做到更多的事情，林辰便打算对阴阳惊天阵有所行动。
叶蓁他们为什么遭遇那阴阳乱流，以及如何才能够解决这麻烦，林辰在不了解具体情况的情况下，的确也没有什么确切的思路。
但有一点是可以肯定的，那就是阴阳庙的一切力量，势必与阴阳惊天阵有关。
只要掌握了大阵，那么任何问题都能够迎刃而解。
林辰现在当然不至于狂妄到可以执掌大阵，但要说做出一定的影响，还是做得到的，只不过具体可以做到何种程度，还需要实际去尝试了才知道。

而眼前一步步往前，每一步林辰都有将自身力量打入大阵中的操作，便是在一点点的影响大阵运转，想要从中夺取一定的主动权。
而第六十六步，就是林辰自己能够做到的极限。
“这大阵实在是玄奥，目前来看，还是有不少区域无法理解”，林辰低语，他也没法看清大阵的全部。
content_en:
Xia Houxiu didn't know why and looked at Lin Chen doubtfully.
"Don't you hope that I can succeed? Then you have to help me. It's too late to explain now. Just get down." Lin Chen said without explaining the reason.
When Xia Houxiu heard this, his expression changed.
It's really hard to accept asking him to cooperate like this without any basis.
But Xiahou Xiu didn't hesitate much, and immediately lay on the ground without saying a word.
It can be seen that he really wants to help Xia Houkui and the others.
Lin Chen raised his eyebrows but didn't say anything more.
He didn't mean to tease Xiahou Xiu, and he didn't mean to make a joke. He had his own reasons for asking Xiahou Xiu to lie down.
The third level of the temple is different from the previous ones.
Here, the influence of the turbulent flow of yin and yang can already be felt. The power of yin and yang flowing in the air becomes more and more manic, and the further forward, the more so.
But that was all, and that was not enough to deter Lin Chen. Lin Chen also planned to continue exploring the third level of the temple, exploring the creation that even the Xiahou family had not found.
"What should I do next?" Xiahou Xiu asked.
He couldn't just lie there forever.
"Just feel it carefully. If you notice any changes, just print them all down and pass them to me. I'll go to the front to take a look now," Lin Chen said lightly, still not explaining anything more.
After saying this, without waiting for Xiahou Xiu's reaction, he dropped a jade and walked forward.
"You should make it clear!" Xiahou Xiu gritted his teeth.
What's going on? Just feel it. What should you feel?
Feel the increasingly manic power in the air?
That is the impact caused by the turbulence of yin and yang. Feeling the changes will indeed help to find Ye Zhen and others after entering the fourth level temple, but this help is really limited.
And if you really want to do this, you should enter the fourth level of the temple.
It will be clearer there!
But Lin Chen had already moved forward on his own. Xia Houxiu was worried that Lin Chen was not innocent and that he really had a purpose in doing so. At the moment, he had no choice but to keep his face dark, lie still, and carefully feel everything he could feel.
But Lin Chen walked forward with an extremely serious expression.
He didn't move around randomly.
Every step he takes is determined according to the formation patterns that originally existed in the third level temple. Every step is a response to the formation and will affect the operation of the formation.
This is actually very difficult.
There can be no mistakes.
Therefore, Lin Chen must also concentrate on using his own Yin-Yang Dao to always feel the power of the Yin-Yang Shocking Formation, and make adjustments at any time to follow the changes in the formation's operation.
Step sixty-six!
In this way, after Lin Chen took sixty-six steps, circles of ripples spread out from under his feet. The entire Yin-Yang Shocking Formation was affected by the power of Yin-Yang injected by Lin Chen, and its operation was artificially changed!
Lin Chen is deliberately affecting the operation of the formation!
Lin Chen had been paying attention to the Yin-Yang Shocking Formation since he entered the Yin-Yang Temple.
In this five-level temple, the Yin-Yang Heaven-shaking Formation at each level is connected together, and together they form this terrifying and world-shattering formation.
The power of this formation was indeed enough to refresh Lin Chen's knowledge. It was even comparable to the killing formation of all worlds that he had seen in the ruins of the God Realm.
Originally, it was best for Lin Chen not to touch this formation, and just follow it within the framework of the formation.
But as Lin Chen's understanding of the Yin-Yang Avenue deepened, and at the same time, more things could be done with the help of the Yin-Yang Life and Death Curse, Lin Chen planned to take action against the Yin-Yang Shocking Formation.
Why did Ye Zhen and the others encounter the turbulence of yin and yang, and how to solve this trouble? Without understanding the specific situation, Lin Chen really didn't have any definite ideas.
But one thing is certain, that is, all the power of the Yin-Yang Temple must be related to the Yin-Yang Shocking Formation.
OnlyOnce you master the Grand Formation, any problem can be easily solved.
Of course, Lin Chen is not arrogant enough to take charge of a large formation now, but he can still make a certain impact, but to what extent he can achieve it, he still needs to actually try it to know.
As he moved forward step by step, Lin Chen had an operation to put his own power into the formation at every step, which was to affect the operation of the formation bit by bit, hoping to seize a certain amount of initiative from it.
And the sixty-sixth step was the limit of what Lin Chen could do.
"This formation is really mysterious. At present, there are still many areas that cannot be understood," Lin Chen whispered, and he could not see the entire formation clearly.
